sounds.name: ui_tap
sounds.purpose: Cursor click / button press on a UI panel
sounds.prompt: Single soft UI click one-shot, premium software interface button press, tight dry plastic-and-glass tick with a tiny rounded low body, very short and clean, high-quality professionally recorded sound effect, no reverb, no music

sounds.name: ui_hover
sounds.purpose: Cursor entering a card / highlight glow
sounds.prompt: Very subtle airy UI hover sound one-shot, soft breathy filtered noise blip, gentle and quiet, modern app interface, short and dry, high-quality sound effect, no music

sounds.name: toggle_switch
sounds.prompt: Crisp mechanical toggle switch one-shot, small precise click-clack of a premium aluminium switch, two quick tight clicks, dry and close, high-quality foley sound effect, no music

sounds.name: panel_open
sounds.purpose: Dashboard panel or modal expanding in
sounds.prompt: Smooth UI panel opening sound, soft upward airy swish with a gentle glassy shimmer at the end, sleek modern software interface, short and clean, high-quality sound effect, no music, no voice

sounds.name: panel_close
sounds.prompt: Smooth UI panel closing sound, soft downward airy swish ending in a muted tight click, sleek modern software interface, short and dry, high-quality sound effect, no music

sounds.name: card_slide
sounds.purpose: A card sliding sideways into place
sounds.prompt: Short UI card slide whoosh, a smooth sheet of frosted glass sliding quickly across a surface and stopping with a soft tap, close and dry, modern interface sound, high-quality sound effect, no music

sounds.name: counter_tick
sounds.purpose: Digits rolling on a data counter (loop under the roll)
sounds.prompt: Rapid soft digital counter ticking, fast even mechanical number-roller clicks like a premium odometer, light and dry, steady rhythm, loopable texture, high-quality sound effect, no music, no beeps

sounds.name: number_land
sounds.purpose: The final number locks in (hero moment)
sounds.prompt: Satisfying UI confirmation impact one-shot, a tight punchy soft thump with a bright glassy click on top and a short warm tonal ring, premium fintech app, clean and short, high-quality sound effect, no music

sounds.name: whoosh_push
sounds.prompt: Fast clean whoosh transition, smooth airy swoosh that builds quickly and stops, modern tech product video, slight low weight underneath, no rumble tail, high-quality sound effect, no music

sounds.name: whoosh_soft
sounds.purpose: Small element moves (chart line, label fly-in)
sounds.prompt: Very short soft whoosh one-shot, light breathy air swipe, subtle and fast, minimal UI motion sound, high-quality sound effect, no music

sounds.name: riser_2s
sounds.purpose: Tension build into a reveal or hook payoff
sounds.prompt: Clean modern riser, 2 seconds, filtered airy noise and a soft synthetic tone rising steadily in pitch and intensity, ends abruptly at the peak, sleek tech product reveal, high-quality sound effect, no drums, no melody
sounds.mix_vs_vo: −10 dB rising to −4 dB; must end on the hit frame

sounds.name: sub_drop
sounds.purpose: Big reveal / chart crash / key stat
sounds.prompt: Deep cinematic sub drop impact, short low boom with a punchy transient and a fast downward pitch sweep, tight controlled tail, modern trailer hit, high-quality sound effect, no music
sounds.mix_vs_vo: −3 dB, VO gap only; add saturated 150–600 Hz phone layer

sounds.name: success_up
sounds.purpose: Positive result (gain, green number, tick mark)
sounds.prompt: Short positive UI success chime, two soft rising bell-like synth notes a fifth apart in D major, warm rounded mallet tone, quick and elegant, fintech app confirmation, high-quality sound effect, no reverb tail

sounds.name: error_down
sounds.prompt: Short negative UI alert, two soft descending synth notes a semitone apart, muted and low, gentle but serious, fintech app warning, not harsh, no buzzer, high-quality sound effect, no reverb tail

sounds.name: sonic_logo
sounds.purpose: AVRON signature on end card (and a 0.5 s hook sting cut from its first two notes)
sounds.prompt: Premium fintech sonic logo, three clean notes in D major: up, down, then a small leap up, warm rounded mallet-and-glass synth tone over a soft low thump, confident and calm, ends with a short shimmer, not a jingle, high-quality sound effect
sounds.mix_vs_vo: 0 dB on end card (no VO); sting −4 dB

sounds.name: room_tone
sounds.purpose: Quiet "studio/product" air bed so silences don't sound dead
sounds.prompt: Very quiet clean room tone of a modern minimal studio, soft constant air and faint electronic hum, no events, no voices, no music, seamless ambience loop

note: glitch_cut from the research spec is dropped: glitch is banned in brand v2 (brand/BRAND.md §6).
